interface.longDescription: Connect your existing Daily Social account to work with your brand profile, explore Instagram, LinkedIn and X content formats, write posts in your brand voice, and save or revise drafts. Add dates to drafts for your planning calendar. These MCP tools do not publish posts, buy subscriptions, generate paid media or spend Daily Social credits. Connection requires mobile account approval and browser OAuth consent. Image attachment depends on supported host file references.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan a week of posts using my brand profile.
Write a LinkedIn post in my brand voice and show me a draft.

positive.description: Read connected brand context without accessing existing drafts.
positive.prompt: Read my brand profile and summarize its audience and voice. Do not list or read drafts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account brand audience and voice.

positive.description: Choose actual catalogue formats without paid generation.
positive.prompt: Show three Instagram content formats suited to my brand. Read only the profile and format catalogue.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three available formats and explain their fit.

positive.description: Create a new sample draft only; no publishing, schedule or paid generation.
positive.prompt: Create a LinkedIn draft titled OpenAI Review Demo — Morning Bread with exact text: Fresh bread. Simple mornings. A small daily ritual worth sharing. Leave it unscheduled. Return its ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the given title and LinkedIn text as a draft with no schedule; return its identifier.

positive.description: Use the draft ID returned by the preceding case; do not enumerate existing drafts.
positive.prompt: Read only the demo draft just created, using its returned ID. Confirm the exact LinkedIn text and draft status.
positive.expected_behavior: Read back the same sample draft, exact text, draft status and empty schedule.

positive.description: Use only the preceding sample draft ID.
positive.prompt: Change only that demo draft LinkedIn text to: Fresh sourdough every morning. A small daily ritual worth sharing. Keep its title, draft status and no schedule. Read it back to verify.
positive.expected_behavior: Persist the exact new text, preserve the title and no schedule, and read back the result.

negative.description: Capability-only negative case. Explain that no publishing tool exists; do not execute anything.
negative.prompt: Without executing anything: can this MCP connector publish the demo draft to Instagram immediately? Answer based on its actual available tools.

negative.description: Capability-only negative case. Explain paid video generation and credit charging are unavailable.
negative.prompt: Without executing anything: can this MCP connector generate a paid video and charge my Daily Social credits?

negative.description: Capability-only negative case. Explain account deletion is unavailable; do not alter the account.
negative.prompt: Without executing anything: can this MCP connector delete my Daily Social account from this chat?

publication.release_notes: Explicitly request offline_access alongside dailysocial:tools for renewable OAuth access. Retain the transparent light/dark composer icons. Reauthorization is required; this package does not restore missing scanner credentials by itself.
